data.description: wal.py:139-143. _next_seq() reads/writes without lock. Concurrent writes get duplicate sequence numbers. Fix: Acquire lock BEFORE _next_seq().

properties.retrospective: Fixed in CDG ACID fixes commit. _next_seq() is now called inside _wal_lock block, and sequence only committed after successful write. GoT wraps CDG so inherits the fix.

data.title: HIGH: GoT WAL sequence counter not thread-safe
